title: Lessons with Manuel Perez from the Auburn book
summary: He had few lessons with Perez, who left for Chicago and sent him to Sidney Desvigne.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Can you tell a little bit about your lessons with Perez? Did he teach you out of the Auburn book or which?

Yes, he did from the Auburn book. But I didn't take too many lessons from him because he left and went to Chicago. Then, so he suggested that I go to Sidney Desveen, had been his pupil previously, maybe, oh I don't know, maybe 10, 12, 15 years previously he had been by his pupil. And in turn he goes out of town. I think it was Chicago if I'm not mistaken.
He was on the boat quite a bit too.
